name: FUNDINNO, Inc.
summary: FUNDINNO, Inc. operates in the financial instruments trading business in Japan. It operates the FUNDINNO small-amount electronic offering business (type 1), the FUNDINNO PLUS+, FUNDINNO MARKET and FUNDINNO MARKET PLUS+ financial instruments businesses, and FUNDOOR and MUFG FUNDOOR. It also provides recruitment services and consulting to support corporate growth. Formerly Japan Cloud Capital, Inc., it dates from 2015 and has its head office in Tokyo, Japan.
